findings.title: Cross-cluster race on same-key remount
findings.problem: Dashboard is not keyed by cluster, so a cluster switch can keep DeploymentFullView mounted with the same key. Combined with the §4 coalescing rule (pendingRef), cluster A's in-flight response still holds the latest request id and gets applied and cached under cluster B. This contradicts 'data never leaks across clusters'.
findings.fix: Use key={`${clusterName}|${activeView}`} in DashboardContent. In the hook, capture reqKey per fetch, cache under reqKey, and apply only when id and reqKey both match current; the reset effect bumps requestIdRef and clears pendingRef.

findings.title: Logs action loses container selection
findings.problem: onOpenLogs({ name, namespace }, c) leaves App.handleOpenLogs with allContainers = [c], because it reads pod.spec.containers/initContainers. Sidecar and init logs become unreachable, a regression compared with the Pods view.
findings.fix: Pass { name, namespace, spec: { containers: non-init names, initContainers: init names } } built from DeploymentPodSummary.containers; type the prop accordingly; firstMainContainerName = first kind==='main'.

findings.title: Effect described inline but §9 says it delegates to decideLiveRefresh
findings.fix: Make the §4 effect call decideLiveRefresh(stateRef.current, liveRv, fetchedRv) and schedule the debounce when action==='debounce'.

findings.title: Token regex misses quoted or punctuated RS names
findings.fix: Use (^|[\s"'(])name($|[\s"',.:)]) and add a quoted-name test.

findings.title: podMetrics can never be forbidden because getPodMetrics swallows errors
findings.fix: UI text: 'Metrics unavailable (metrics-server missing or no permission)'.

findings.title: Worst-case aggregate latency not stated
findings.fix: State that settle timeouts are per call and document the ~70 s bound; optionally use a 10 s per-section default.

findings.title: SchedulingConstraints raw JSON scope
findings.fix: Serialize only the scheduling fields, never the whole template.spec (which holds unmasked env).

findings.title: Actions column renders without a handler
findings.fix: Append the column only when onOpenFullView is defined.

findings.title: DrawerRevision.creationTimestamp is a Date over IPC
findings.fix: Type it as string | Date and keep the YAML output byte-identical with the fixture.
